verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry or usage-tracking controls for the Graphite CLI or web app. The privacy material it does contain covers something else: AI features are opt-in and not used for model training, and an org-wide AI block can be requested by email. That is AI data-handling and feature gating, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage analytics. The documented `gt config` menu shows no telemetry setting either, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
